rag_to_rom_graduation_criterion.governance: One-way doors stay RESPONSIVE forever; a reflex at an irreversible threshold is the rogue operator by definition. Irreversible/etch -> write-lock + serializable. Same gravity invariant at three layers: agent autonomy, DB isolation, canon writes -- free where reversible, locked where not.

Run-dependent; no number claimed (claiming one = fabrication). The etch is itself a one-way door, so pond-formation is subject to its own invariant (short leash, falsify first, do not etch on momentum): the gravity well is governed by its own gravity.
